test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_lc_build_{distinct} (s LowCardinality(String), INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple();
CREATE TABLE text_index_lc_array_build_{distinct} (tags Array(LowCardinality(String)), INDEX idx tags TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple();
CREATE TABLE text_index_lc_build_src_{distinct} (s String, tags Array(String)) ENGINE = Memory;
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_lc_build_src_{distinct} SELECT concat('service-', toString(cityHash64(number) % {distinct})), arrayMap(x -> concat('tag-', toString(cityHash64(number, x) % {distinct})), range(10)) FROM numbers(1000000);
test.query: INSERT INTO text_index_lc_build_{distinct} SELECT s FROM text_index_lc_build_src_{distinct}
INSERT INTO text_index_lc_array_build_{distinct} SELECT tags FROM text_index_lc_build_src_{distinct}
